effects: Require msg.sender == factory and supplied administrator/principal equals current administrator. Enforce shared APR, delinquency fee, withdrawal batch duration, reserve ratio and delinquency-grace bounds. Require at least 96 hooks-data bytes and validate first-window/period/window-duration parameters; store schedule, entry flags, minimum and isClosed=false in _hookedMarkets[marketAddress]. Reject withdrawal-access configurations without deposit access and either transfer access or disabled transfers. Record depositHookEnabled in the stored HookedMarket struct. A positive minimum forces deposit callback and emits MinimumDepositUpdated; disabled transfers force transfer callback; queue callback forces deposit/transfer flags; merge advertised optional/required flags and return the resulting HooksConfig. PeriodicTermUpdated is emitted for the initial schedule.
